query:
UPDATE tags
            SET
                name        = COALESCE($3, name),
                category_id = CASE
                    WHEN $5::bool THEN NULL
                    ELSE COALESCE($4, category_id)
                END,
                color       = COALESCE($6, color)
            WHERE
                id = $1
                AND user_id = $2
            RETURNING
                id,
                user_id,
                category_id,
                name,
                color,
                created_at,
                updated_at
